CRI ADX decoder and encryption references

The decoder in audio-adx.js follows the ADX
format, decoding, key derivation, and known-key scale checks documented by
vgmstream. adx-keys.js contains the 64 type-8 and 24 type-9 known key entries
from vgmstream's adx_keys.h. Runtime code is JavaScript, with source-backed
reads; it does not bundle or execute vgmstream, VGAudio, or FFmpeg.

Primary references (retrieved 2026-10-31):
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/master/src/meta/adx.c
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/master/src/coding/adx_decoder.c
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/master/src/meta/adx_keys.h
https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream/blob/master/src/util/cri_keys.c
https://github.com/Thealexbarney/VGAudio/blob/master/src/VGAudio/Codecs/CriAdx/CriAdxCodec.cs
https://github.com/Thealexbarney/VGAudio/blob/master/src/VGAudio/Codecs/CriAdx/CriAdxEncryption.cs
https://github.com/Thealexbarney/VGAudio/blob/master/src/VGAudio/Codecs/CriAdx/CriAdxKey.cs
